headline: Godawari Power And Ispat Limited: SEBI Takeover Regulation 10(6) Disclosure filed by Kumar Agrawal

detail: The disclosure indicates an acquisition event in Godawari Power And Ispat Limited (a power and steel producer listed on NSE/BSE). Kumar Agrawal has made the Regulation 10(6) report to the Exchange, which is required when a shareholder acquires shares in reliance on an exemption under Regulation 10 of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The specific exemption and acquisition quantum are not disclosed in the Bar & Bench headline extract; the full disclosure form filed with NSE would contain the precise share count, percentage, consideration (if any), and the exemption basis.
